typing.display_clock: 60 Hz (a 1 px composited animation keeps the frame clock running, as a real panel does)

bar_app_internal.definition: keystroke hardware timestamp -> commitFinishTime of the frame carrying it (Chrome EventTiming), text-affecting keystrokes only
bar_app_internal.bar: <= 5 ms average, <= 16 ms worst case (REFERENCE 5.3; Fatin Typometer means: Notepad++ 4.3, Emacs 5.3, Sublime 8.2)

input_injection.how: CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent — the clock starts inside the browser process, so the kernel/libinput/compositor delivery hop is NOT included

autosave.note: files.js flushes the whole document to localStorage 400 ms after the last change; a run that never pauses never triggers it.
